headline: Metaphor ReFantazio on Switch 2!
title: Metaphor ReFantazio Switch 2 Release Date November 12 | Lower Price | Gaming News
video_script: Metaphor ReFantazio is heading to Nintendo Switch 2! Atlus Studio Zero's fantasy RPG arrives on Switch 2 on November twelfth, twenty twenty six, at a lower price than earlier versions. The game first launched in October twenty twenty four on PlayStation, Xbox and PC. In the West, a limited SteelBook Edition will also be available at launch. Will you pick it up? Comment below!
description: Metaphor: ReFantazio, the fantasy RPG from Atlus Studio Zero, launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on November 12, 2026 at a lower price than earlier versions. Limited SteelBook Edition in the West.
